title: KVBuffer Qwen3.6-27B Ascend piercing

paper.title: KVBuffer: IO-aware Serving for Linear Attention
paper.reference_stack: SGLang v0.5.10, Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct, four NVIDIA L40S GPUs
paper.official_code_status: No paper-linked public implementation or repository was found at activation time; do not call a target implementation paper-exact.

target.delivery: disabled-by-default plugin monkeypatch with version-independent core and thin adapters

acceptance.performance: at least 10 percent end-to-end output-throughput gain versus matched control
acceptance.quality: no final LongBench-v2 or GSM8K regression; thinking disabled, max_tokens 2048, normal EOS

scope.primary: non-speculative chunkwise decode buffering for Gated DeltaNet
scope.algorithm_identity: faithful-port only if paper equations and state lifecycle are preserved; any wider Ascend fusion is a derivative

current_evidence.note: Diagnostic real-NPU share, not end-to-end performance.

terminal_result.reason: The faithful non-speculative path cannot reach 1.10x even if its recurrent operator is removed entirely. An intentionally over-attributed derivative would need to eliminate more than 90 percent of a scope containing mandatory work.

next_actions: Do not implement or rerun KVBuffer unchanged for the current non-speculative 1024-token objective.
Activate DeltaLog as the next paper and gate its batch/concurrency transfer against the same real decode profile.
Reopen KVBuffer only if speculative decoding is explicitly authorized or the runtime profile materially changes.
